name: Lithuania

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of yellow, green and red.
flag.symbolism: Yellow stands for the sun and prosperity, green for forests and hope, and red for courage and the blood shed for the country.

hook: Sun over forest over red earth: Lithuania is yellow-green-red from the top with nothing else on it; Myanmar adds a white star, and Bolivia starts with red.
trivia: First adopted in 1918, the flag was banned under Soviet rule and restored in 1989; its proportions changed from 1:2 to 3:5 in 2004.
French geographers placed the geographical centre of Europe just north of Vilnius in 1989.
